svg.title: nMEMORY: Hybrid Vector Embeddings, System1 (Laya / Jev) & Curator Graph
svg.desc: Architectural diagram showing nMEMORY hybrid vector embeddings, taint shield, System1 engine batching with order-ensembles, and resident curator with two-axis DoD knowledge graph.

g.text: nMEMORY: Hybrid Vector Embeddings, System1 (Laya / Jev) & Curator Graph
Resilient dual-lane retrieval with taint shields, high-throughput probabilistic reasoning, and continuous two-axis DoD verification
• Margin Gate: 0.083 cosine margin gate rejects ambiguous ties
Pre-filters dense candidate partition before fusion ranking
• Robust to accents, Portuguese inflections & code tokens
• Raw turn stream inspection before memory extraction
• Escape valve option: "nenhuma" when below confidence
Forward + reverse order run in parallel
• Prevents hallucinatory drift as code files mutate
Stale excerpts quarantined automatically in nMEMORY
No subjective self-declaration without factual witness
• Graph updates are monotonic, durable & audited
Single Source of Truth across multi-agent campaigns
nMEMORY SPEC: DUAL-LANE EMBEDDINGS (SQLITE-VEC + FTS5) · SYSTEM1 PROBABILISTIC (NOTT-SYSTEM1) · RESIDENT CURATOR 2-AXIS GRAPH
